subject: PICTURE clause
notes: LANDED 2026-09-13 (kb/Work PB530), both sentences, RE-DERIVED on the tree. The rule needs no code of its own: 13.18.40.6 Table 10's leading-currency ROW admits ONLY the leading-sign column, which is sentence 1's 'leftmost symbol in character-string-1, optionally preceded by one of the symbols + or -' exactly, and only a trailing sign or CR/DB may follow a trailing currency symbol, which is its second half. Measured at all four editions: 01 W1 PIC 99$9 and 01 W1 PIC 9$99+ are COBOL1935 where they used to bind (witness PD06 of negative/pb528-picture-precedence). THE FALSE-REJECTION CONTROL IS THE RULE'S OWN NOTE 4 LIST, and all six bind AND edit correctly on this tree (MOVE 12): '$999+' [$012+], '+999$' [+012$], '+$999' [+$012], '999$+' [012$+], '+$$99' [+ $12], '$$99+' [ $12+] - five of the six are entries of 85/pb528_picture_composition_legal_85. SENTENCE 2 ('For extended editing sign control, the currency symbol ... leftmost ... optionally preceded by character-1, or the rightmost ... optionally followed by character-1') is carried by the SAME matrix with the extended character-1 given the cs roles and exempted from the cs-vs-es order (kb/Work PB855): PIC L$999 and PIC 999$L bind and render [($012] / [012$(] at 2023 (golden 2023/pb530_picture_editing_order_2023 E05/E06, and `PIC L$999F` [($012)] E08), while PIC 99$9L - a currency symbol that is neither leftmost nor rightmost - is COBOL1935 (negative/pb530-picture-editing-currency-placement). THE SINGULAR 'optionally preceded by character-1' is settled by SR25 as written: with two extended symbols the first IS the leftmost symbol, so `PIC LF$999` (two ahead of the currency symbol) is COBOL1984 (negative/pb855-picture-editing-es-two-before-cs) - the residue the previous record left open is closed. An IS-form character-1 beside the currency symbol stays unconstrained (rule 3: simple insertion; no rule counts it against this sentence). || editions: sentence 1 at 85, 2002, 2014, 2023; sentence 2 at 2023 only (the EDITING phrase is a COBOL-2023 introduction). retired-witness: unit:PictureCompositionTests.APrecedenceViolation_IsCOBOLNET1935 (the same witness, re-spelled when the diagnostic code prefix became COBOL#### (kb/Work PB3575); the new spelling is recorded in its place)
